description: Implementation of NetworkInterfaceCache class for managing network interfaces on Fuchsia platform, including adding, updating, removing interfaces, and determining connection types.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceCache
classes.description: Caches network interface information, manages interface lifecycle, and determines network connection type.

methods.name: AddInterfaces
methods.description: Adds multiple network interfaces and returns change bits or nullopt on failure.

methods.name: AddInterfaceWhileLocked
methods.description: Internal method to add interface with lock held, verifies and updates interface info.

methods.name: GetOnlineInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of online, non-loopback interfaces.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets error state, clears interface data.

methods.name: UpdateConnectionTypeWhileLocked
methods.description: Recalculates connection type based on current interfaces.

methods.name: SetErrorWhileLocked
methods.description: Internal method to set error state with lock held.
